caption: A bowl of shoyu ramen glows with rich, amber broth, topped with a whole boiled egg and tender chashu pork. Fresh greens and a red garnish crown the noodles, all nestled in a white ceramic bowl against warm wooden tones under soft, inviting light.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and warm brown tones.
Chashu pork appears as tender, thinly sliced meat with pinkish-brown hue and slight sheen, showing soft, slightly curled edges.
A whole boiled egg, pale beige, smooth and glossy, oval-shaped with subtle surface highlights and a faint red string.
The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is amber-brown, translucent, and glossy, with visible noodles and green garnish floating within.
White ceramic bowl with smooth, glossy surface, subtle rim ridges, and faint light reflections.
